## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the closest relevant tests or documented why I could not.
- [ ] I verified the app builds without requiring release signing credentials.

## Security and scope

- [ ] I added no secrets, private recordings, transcripts, or personal data.
- [ ] I kept the change focused and called out any follow-up work.
- [ ] I updated public documentation when behavior changed, or it was not needed.
